**Pipeline controller notification**
This repo is configured to use the [pipeline controller](https://docs.ci.openshift.org/how-tos/creating-a-pipeline/). Second-stage tests will be triggered either automatically or after lgtm label is added, depending on the repository configuration. The pipeline controller will automatically detect which contexts are required and will utilize `/test` Prow commands to trigger the second stage.

For optional jobs, comment `/test ?` to see a list of all defined jobs. To trigger manually all jobs from second stage use `/pipeline required` command. 

This repository is configured in: automatic mode

Skipping CI for Draft Pull Request.
If you want CI signal for your change, please convert it to an actual PR.
You can still manually trigger a test run with `/test all`

## Walkthrough The upgrade recommendation tests now detect HyperShift and CVO alert evaluation during setup, use the cluster feature gate to determine evaluation mode, reuse stored state, and skip incompatible conditional recommendation assertions. ### Changes **Upgrade recommendation evaluation** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Detect cluster evaluation mode**
`test/extended/cli/adm_upgrade/recommend.go`|Adds shared HyperShift and CVO evaluation state and determines alert evaluation from the target ClusterVersion’s cluster feature gate, while forcing HyperShift clusters to local evaluation.| |**Apply evaluation-specific test handling**
`test/extended/cli/adm_upgrade/recommend.go`|Reuses the stored HyperShift state, skips the conditional recommendations context when alerts are evaluated by CVO, and adds TODOs for remaining conditional handling.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 14 | ❌ 1 ### ❌ Failed checks (1 warning) | Check name | Status | Explanation | Resolution | | :------------------------: | :--------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | Test Structure And Quality | ⚠️ Warning | alertsEvaluatedByCVO errors on FeatureGate/cluster NotFound, so BeforeAll can fail on default-feature clusters instead of treating risks as disabled. | Return (false, nil) for apierrors.IsNotFound(err) in alertsEvaluatedByCVO, and keep propagating other errors. |
✅ Passed checks (14 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped because no linked issues were found for this pull request. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | All Ginkgo titles in the changed file are static literals; no dynamic names or changing values appear in test titles. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The test uses ClusterVersion/FeatureGate APIs, but a top-level BeforeAll detects MicroShift and g.Skip()s before those calls. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The new tests only use a single update-service pod and API-driven setup; no multi-node/HA assumptions or missing SNO guards were introduced. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | PASS: The PR only changes a test file and adds no deployment manifests, controllers, or node-affinity/anti-affinity/topology-spread settings. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | No stdout writes were added in suite-level code; recommend.go only uses GinkgoWriter-backed framework.Logf and buffers command output. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No IPv4-only assumptions or public-internet connectivity were added; the test uses cluster-internal service URLs and IPv6-safe host/port handling. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | No MD5/SHA1/DES/RC4/3DES/Blowfish/ECB, custom crypto, or secret comparisons found in the modified test file. | | Container-Privileges | ✅ Passed | No privileged settings were added in the diff; no new logging/printing of tokens, hostnames, or PII was introduced. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly matches the PR’s main change: temporarily skipping recommend command tests for the new output. |
